music.creditedName: ティームエンタテインメント
music.name: ティームエンタテインメント

segments.text: "Why should I be sad? It's a part of me."

The protagonist. A young girl with poison flowing through her veins that causes imminent death with a single touch. She was whisked away by Arsène escaping arrest by the Royal Guards after being deemed a monster and a threat to public safety. As her memory only goes back two years, she is desperate to find her father, who may hold the key to what came before.
Taken from the official website
Age: Unknown
"Don't worry. Stay with me and you'll soon be able to laugh and cry again-- All I do is for you."

A notorious and nefarious master thief who is perpetually cheerful, optimistic, and overflowing with confidence — traits more than justified given his overwhelming success. After encountering Cardia, he whisks her away to London for reasons known only to himself.
Taken from the official website

cast.characterName: エイブラハム・ヴァン・ヘルシング
cast.originalCharacterName: エイブラハム・ヴァン・ヘルシング

segments.text: "I'm looking for someone. Why, you ask? So I can kill him, of course."

A vampire hunter renowned for his ability to overcome even the strongest and most evil vampires. Being a former member of the British Army, his superior physical conditioning and combat abilities almost warrant the metaphor of “Human Weapon.” For personal justification, he is in search of someone to settle a long-standing score.
Taken from the official website

cast.characterName: ヴィクター・フランケンシュタイン
cast.originalCharacterName: ヴィクター・フランケンシュタイン

segments.text: "Despite being almost petrified by fear, I managed to escape... I'm the worst person you'll ever meet."

A researcher who once had ties to the British Government. Though his knowledge and intelligence are unrivaled, he is genuinely humble and self-deprecating. In addition to being very sociable, he is easily swayed by others. After an unfortunate series of events, he is now a wanted criminal.
Taken from the official website

cast.characterName: インピー・バービケーン
cast.originalCharacterName: インピー・バービケーン

segments.text: "I believe that the day will come when everyone will be able to smile together."

A man who accompanied Lupin to London. He is energetic, care-free, and tends to get carried away fairly easily, but no one can deny his extraordinary ingenuity. He is searching for an important item that was taken from him long ago.
Taken from the official website
"What, you don't trust me? Can't say I blame you. There are times when I don't trust myself."

A wealthy landowner with a mansion in London and a gentleman at heart with an air of grace and dignity. He graciously opens the doors of his home to the protagonist and her party. He is somewhat of strange bird but he is happy to help everyone for the amusement it provides.
Taken from the official website.
Age: Unknown
"Sister, I will not let you get away, no matter what it takes."

A young, enigmatic boy who is the head of Twilight, a mysterious intelligence agency. No one really knows anything about him, not even his age. Rumors persist that he may be immortal. He is hell-bent on capturing Cardia for reasons known only to himself.
Taken from the official website
Age: Unknown

cast.characterName: エルロック・ショルメ
cast.originalCharacterName: エルロック・ショルメ

segments.text: "Everything is interconnected at some level; mortality means very little in the grand scheme of things."
A private detective who came to London upon being summoned by Scotland Yard.

His excellent physical condition and superior intellect is without peer, and his ability to remain preternaturally calm at all times is legendary. He is also a constant thorn in the side of the protagonist and her allies, though he occasionally acts as their savior.
He makes it a point to keep his professional and private lives completely separate.
Taken from the official website
His real name is Sherlock Holmes, a famous detective, who has been pursuing the whereabouts of his arch-rival, James Moriarty.

cast.characterName: ジミー・A・アレスター
cast.originalCharacterName: ジミー・A・アレスター

segments.text: "Be careful. It doesn't take much to get someone killed."
An elderly gentleman who is Twilight’s second-in-command and runs their operations division. His nature is always calm and exceedingly polite. He and Helsing have apparently crossed paths before.
Taken from the official website
His true name is James Moriarty, a criminal mastermind and arch-rival of Sherlock Holmes, who has been going under a false identity throughout the story.

cast.characterName: アレクサンドリナ・ヴィクトリア
cast.originalCharacterName: アレクサンドリナ・ヴィクトリア

segments.text: "I am truly envious. There is no need to fear what you do not know."
The reigning Queen of Britain.

Despite her overly-grandiose and extravagant appearance and behavior, she is an incredibly effective monarch who puts the well-being of her subjects and the growth of her nation above all else. She is somehow acquainted with Cardia’s father.
Taken from the official website
"There is only one true genius! And it's MEEEEEEEEE!"

A scientist claiming to be the world’s preeminent researcher whose actions are questionable at best. Due to his irrational behavior, people rarely desire to interact with him. Yet there is no question he is quite the genius — with a moral compass more than a little skewed. He firmly believes no sacrifice is too great to complete his research, as long as he isn’t the one doing the sacrificing.
Taken from the official website
"Fear me, foolish humans!"
The offspring of one of the few vampires to survive eradication by humanity, the intense grudge he holds against Helsing is more than justified in his mind.
Despite still being a child, he has benefitted greatly from being a vampire; for example he is far stronger than he appears.
Taken from the official website
His birth name is Dracula Delacroix. He took on the name "Delacroix II" after the death of his father, Delacroix.

cast.characterName: ランパール・レオンハルト
cast.originalCharacterName: ランパール・レオンハルト

segments.text: "Everything is for the glory of her majesty, the Queen!"

A soldier in the British Army, his magnificent beard is only equaled by his strong sense of justice and national pride. Although he does his best to advance the cause of his queen and country, his over exuberance often makes his hard work for naught.
He also holds a very personal and deep-seated grudge against Lupin.
Taken from the official website
"...I think I'm just going to kill you all."
A member of the organization known as Idea. Specializing in martial arts, they care for nothing other than brutally and mercilessly crushing their foes.
Taken from the official website
Age: Unknown
Her true identity is Guinevere, former queen consort of King Arthur Pendragon.
"Welcome. Care for a spot of tea?"
The commanding officer of the organization known as Idea. After a seemingly random encounter, she becomes deeply involved with Cardia. She is a gentle soul who loves nature, peace, and harmony.
Taken from the official website
Age: Unknown

cast.characterName: シャーリー・ゴードン
cast.originalCharacterName: シャーリー・ゴードン

segments.text: Darius's daughter. Perhaps it is because of her age, but she strongly dislikes it when her father intervenes in her life. Born into a life of interacting with adults, she is very mature; far more knowledgeable than other children her age and capable of dealing with societal complications. Due to a certain event, she becomes friends with Cardia.
From the official website

The boss of the Gordon Family, a mafia group based out of London. A giant of a man with an exuberant personality, he comes off as incredibly intimidating, but he is actually quite the gentleman, and champions the weak. It is extremely obvious to everyone that he dotes on his child to an overwhelming degree.
From the official website

cast.characterName: アヴィド・クルデーレ
cast.originalCharacterName: アヴィド・クルデーレ

segments.text: A mysterious man who has a connection with Darius.
A young man who works for the Gordon family.

One of the 13 Apostles sent by Idea. A quiet young man, his personality shifts are so numerous that he is difficult to read. His specialty is his ability to search, and he is known to be able to find anyone no matter what, regardless of where they may hide.
From the official website
His name is Hansel Hexenhouse (ハンセル・ヘクセンハウス).
A white haired diva whose eye covered with an eyepatch.
She met Lupin at the theater where she was singing, and will be heavily involved in the story.
